one_line: Western Kshatrapa mahākshatrapa of Saurashtra and Malwa, a conquering ruler and praised patron of learning.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with a strong jaw, straight nose, wheatish-brown complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, default expression calm but confident with a hint of stern authority
appearance.hair: thick dark-brown hair gathered into a short topknot at the back of the crown, sides combed back, front smooth without fringe, topped with a modest conical turban-like cloth headwrap in deep red with a narrow gold band at the base
appearance.costume: He wears an early 2nd-century western Indian royal outfit: a knee-length, long-sleeved tunic of fine off‑white cotton with a round neck and subtle woven borders, belted at the waist with a broad dark-red cloth sash; over this, a diagonally draped mantled shawl (uttariya) in deep indigo with narrow gold and maroon stripes along the edges, pinned at the right shoulder so his right arm is free; fitted churidar-style trousers in muted sand-brown, slightly gathered at the ankles; sturdy mid-calf leather boots dyed dark brown, plain but well-made; jewellery kept dignified— a single medium-thick gold torque necklace, one simple gold armlet on his left upper arm, a pair of small round gold earrings, and a narrow signet ring on his right hand; armour is limited to a subtle brown leather chest-guard worn under the shawl, hinted by faint seams and thickness under the tunic, maintaining historical plausibility for a mobile kshatrapa commander.
appearance.signature: A straight-edged iron longsword inspired by early Indian–Indo-Scythian styles, with a slightly broad, double-edged blade about thigh to calf length, a simple iron crossguard, and a dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt capped with a plain rounded pommel, carried in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his left hip on a dark-red belt.

ref_desc: Rudradaman I is a mid-30s, wheatish-brown, strong-jawed man with a short topknot under a deep-red conical headwrap, wearing an off-white tunic, indigo shawl with gold stripes, sand-brown trousers, dark-brown boots, modest gold jewellery, and a straight iron longsword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rudradaman I as a dignified 2nd-century CE Western Kshatrapa ruler: a mid-30s, athletic, wheatish-brown man with an oval, strong-jawed face, neat short beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes and calm, authoritative expression; his thick dark-brown hair is gathered into a short topknot and covered by a modest deep-red conical cloth headwrap with a narrow gold band. Dress him in an off-white, knee-length, long-sleeved cotton tunic with subtle woven borders, belted by a broad dark-red sash, over fitted sand-brown churidar trousers and sturdy dark-brown mid-calf leather boots; show a diagonally draped deep indigo shawl (uttariya) with narrow gold and maroon edge stripes pinned at his right shoulder, hinting a light brown leather chest-guard beneath the tunic. Add restrained gold jewellery: a medium-thick torque necklace, one gold armlet on his left upper arm, small round gold earrings, and a narrow signet ring on his right hand. At his left hip, hang a straight-edged iron longsword in a brown leather scabbard from a dark-red belt; ensure the sword’s simple crossguard and leather-wrapped hilt are clearly visible. Present him front-facing in a confident, composed stance with slight three-quarter head turn, and clearly show his consistent face, topknot and headwrap, layered garments, colours in the deep indigo, dark red, off-white, sand-brown, dark brown and gold palette, and the sword as his signature prop.
